titulo: The conditional: futuro do pretérito: Forming the conditional

aula.objetivo: Form the futuro do pretérito (the «would» tense, endings -ia, -ias, -ia, -íamos, -iam) to make polite requests, give advice, say what you would do and talk about imagined or possible situations.

itens.pt: I would like; he/she/you would like
I/he/she/you would be able to; could

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: the futuro do pretérito (English «conditional», the «would» tense) is formed from the whole infinitive plus the endings -ia, -ias, -ia, -íamos, -iam. The same endings are used for -ar, -er and -ir verbs: «falar» becomes «falaria», «comer» becomes «comeria», «partir» becomes «partiria». STEP 2: do not drop anything from the infinitive. If you already know the simple future («falarei», «comerei»), just replace the future endings with the endings above. STEP 3: three verbs have a short stem, exactly as in the simple future: «dizer» becomes «diria», «fazer» becomes «faria», «trazer» becomes «traria». All other verbs are regular here, even the ones that are irregular in the present: «ser» becomes «seria», «ter» becomes «teria», «ir» becomes «iria», «vir» becomes «viria», «estar» becomes «estaria», «poder» becomes «poderia». STEP 4: the stress falls on the «-ri-» of the ending («fala-RI-a», «fa-RI-a»), and «nós» has a written accent: «falaríamos». STEP 5: «você», «ele», «ela» and «a gente» take the same form as «eu». In the plural, «vocês», «eles» and «elas» take the -iam form.
blocos.comparacao: In English you need the extra word «would»: «I would speak», «she would go». Portuguese puts the «would» inside the verb: one word, «eu falaria», «ela iria». Be careful with the other English «would», the one that means «used to» («When I was a kid, we would play outside every day»). That one is not the conditional in Portuguese: it is the imperfeito («a gente brincava»).

Other useful verbs (regular in this tense)

erros.motivo: The ending -ia is added to the full infinitive «gostar»: «gostar» + «ia». Only one «r» is written before «ia».

erros.errado: Quando eu era criança, eu jogaria bola todo dia.
erros.certo: Quando eu era criança, eu jogava bola todo dia.
erros.motivo: The English «would» for a past habit is not the conditional in Portuguese. Use the imperfeito.

blocos.enunciado: Say aloud what you would do on a free Saturday in your city, with five different verbs in the conditional: «Eu dormiria até tarde. Eu faria um bom café. Eu iria…». Then say the same with «a gente» as the subject.

Say aloud three things you will do next week with the simple future from lesson 27 («eu farei», «ele dirá», «nós viajaremos»), then three polite requests with «queria» and «poderia» from lesson 29. Today these two worlds meet: the conditional is built on the same stem as the future.
